notes.title: Gray Dawn UPDATE!
notes.content:
Thank you very much, guys, for supporting Gray Dawn! As you see now, the game has received Very Positive reviews and that's just because of you! As a token of gratitude, we want to present you with the first update of the game. Hope you enjoy it and please if you encounter problems let us know! God bless!
The update contains:
*controller support
*achievements
*German, Romanian, Hungarian subtitles

notes.title: LIVE STREAM today and a REQUEST from us
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32701555/2cc7c1874203d8cbab1a23315f49a87ec765d755.png[/img]

Hey everyone!

It's been almost 2 weeks now since the release of Gray Dawn. After over 3 years of hard work in a group of just 3 people, seeing our first big game released on Steam with so many great reviews feels like a dream come true. We are extremely happy with the feedback we've been receiving, both from you on Steam, and from various YouTubers that we highlighted in our latest [url=http://eepurl.com/ds9ee5]newsletter[/url] as well as from websites that have already reviewed Gray Dawn. 

As a way of expressing our gratitude and to connect with our fans better, we are organizing a live stream on our [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCr_Wl0hOPgkgInwqQvhi2zw]YouTube Channel[/url] today at 6 pm GMT. We are going to play a fragment from Gray Dawn while talking about the game (including some behind-the-scenes details) and answering your questions. What's more, you will also get a chance to finally play Gray Dawn if you haven't done it yet as we will be giving out the game keys during the stream as well! We can't wait to see all of you there with us today!

We also wanted to take this opportunity to ask you for some additional support. Even though Gray Dawn has been received very well and the majority of you seem to enjoy it, the game is not selling as well as we expected. We would love to continue creating ambitious, engaging and unique experiences for you but this is obviously predicated on our budget. The more copies of Gray Dawn we sell, the easier it's going to be for us to develop new games as well as further develop Gray Dawn, e.g. by bringing it to new platforms or maybe even creating additional content.

That's why we are asking you to recommend our game to your friends as well as leave us a review on Steam (and on [url=http://www.metacritic.com/game/pc/gray-dawn] Metacritic [/url]) if you haven't done so yet. We currently have a "Positive" rather than "Very Positive" score despite over 90% positive reviews due to a relatively small number of reviews. With 10 more reviews or so, we will be able to get to a "Very Positive" score on Steam which should result in better visibility of Gray Dawn on Steam. So if you've got a moment and you enjoyed Gray Dawn, please publish a review! 

Thank you so much for all your support!
George, Eduard, Razvan from your Interactive Stone team

notes.title: The Wait is Almost Over! Gray Dawn is Coming Out June 7th, 2018.
notes.content:
[i]The end of all things is near; therefore, be of sound judgment and sober spirit for the purpose of prayer.
- 1 Peter 4:7[/i]

I know you've been anxiously waiting for a release date. Well, I'm here to finally tell you that Gray Dawn is coming out June 7th, 2018! So, go and grab your exorcism tools. It's almost time for you to immerse yourself in the world of Gray Dawn and find out the mystery behind the missing altar boy. 

We also have just released 8 minutes of  gameplay footage for you to view: 

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=S-PIyW33ML8

To stay up to date on all things Gray Dawn, make sure you’re following our [url=https://www.facebook.com/GrayDawnGame]Facebook[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/StoneInteract]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/interactivestone/]Instagram[/url], and join our [url=http://eepurl.com/ds9ee5]Newsletter[/url].

notes.title: Catholic guilt simulator Gray Dawn rises in June
notes.content:
On Christmas Eve 1910, you attempt to exorcise the demon from an altar-boy. You’re qualified for this position because you’re a priest and you think you’re capable of taking this on. Turns out you aren’t and the kid jumps out a window. Now you’re suspected of murdering a little boy in your church and you’ve got to prove your innocence. You’ll be put to death if you can’t. Oh, and you absolutely set loose a demon that is tormenting you. Welcome to Gray Dawn, which is set to release in June.

(more…)

notes.title: Your Prayers Have Been Answered! Gray Dawn Is Coming Out This June!
notes.content:
